name: Certificate in Computer Applications
shortDescription: Master computer fundamentals, typing mastery, Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), and internet productivity.
fullDescription: Designed for complete beginners, students, and office workers seeking foundational computer literacy. You will learn PC operating systems, fast typing techniques, document formatting in Microsoft Word, spreadsheet calculations in Excel, dynamic presentations in PowerPoint, and efficient email/cloud workflows.
modules: Computer Fundamentals & OS Navigation
Keyboarding & Fast Typing Mastery
Microsoft Word (Document Formatting & Reports)
Microsoft Excel (Formulas, Functions & Data Entry)
Microsoft PowerPoint (Slide Design & Presentations)
Internet Research, Email Etiquette & Cloud Storage
targetAudience: Beginners, School Leavers, Administrative Assistants, Office Professionals

name: AI Tools for Business & Productivity
shortDescription: Leverage ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and automation tools to 10x your daily business and work output.

ChatGPT & Claude for Content, Reports & Email Writing
AI in Spreadsheets (Excel & Google Sheets AI formulas)

Ethics, Privacy & Verification of AI Outputs

name: Graphic Design
shortDescription: Create stunning visual brand identities, flyers, social media graphics, and logos using CorelDraw and Adobe Photoshop.

CorelDraw Vector Design & Print Layouts
Adobe Photoshop (Photo Editing, Retouching & Compositing)
Branding: Logos, Stationery, Mockups & Brand Guides
Social Media Post & Banner Design (Canva + Pro Tools)
Print Preparation, Color Separation & Client Portfolio Building
